question: When 1272, 2636 and 4209 are divided by the greatest number x, the remainder in each case is y. What is the value of (3x − 14y)?
solution:
**Given:**

1272, 2636, and 4209 leave same remainder y when divided by greatest number x

Find: (3x − 14y)

**Formula used:**

If numbers leave same remainder y when divided by x, then difference of numbers is divisible by x

So, x = HCF of (2636−1272), (4209−2636), and (4209−1272)

**Calculations:**

2636 − 1272 = 1364

4209 − 2636 = 1573

4209 &a
